description_en: Obtains the playback URL of a media file (video or audio) by audio or video ID. After integrating the Alibaba Cloud Player SDK (for URL-based playback) or a third-party player, you can use the URL for audio and video playback
description_zh: 本接口通过音视频ID直接获取媒体文件（支持视频和音频）的播放地址。集成阿里云播放器SDK（适用于URL播放方式）或第三方播放器后，可使用该地址进行音视频播放
name: GetPlayInfo

parameters.help_en:
The media asset ID.

At least one of MediaId and InputURL must be specified
parameters.help_zh:
媒资ID。

MediaId和InputURL字段中至少一个不能为空
parameters.name: media_id

parameters.help_en:
The InputURL specified when the media asset was registered. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/441152.html.

At least one of MediaId and InputURL must be specified
parameters.help_zh:
注册媒资时填写的InputURL，详情见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/441152.html。

MediaId和InputURL字段中至少一个不能为空
parameters.name: input_url

CateId.description_en:
The category ID. You can obtain the category ID by using the following methods:
Log on to the IMS console (https://ims.console.aliyun.com) and choose Media Asset Management > Category Management to view the category ID.
When you create a category by calling the create category operation, the category ID is the value of CateId in the response.
When you query a category by calling the get category operation, the category ID is the value of CateId in the response
CateId.description_zh:
分类ID。可通过以下方式获取：
登录IMS控制台 (https://ims.console.aliyun.com)，选择 媒资管理 > 分类管理查看分类ID。
通过创建分类接口创建分类时，分类ID为返回参数CateId的值。
通过获取分类接口查询分类时，为请求后返回参数CateId的值

MediaTags.description_en:
The tags.

A maximum of 16 tags are supported.

Separate multiple tags with commas (,).

Each tag can be up to 32 bytes in length.

UTF-8 encoding is used
MediaTags.description_zh:
标签。

最多不超过16个标签。

多个用逗号分隔。

单个标签不超过32字节。

UTF8编码

MediaType.description_en:
The media file type. Valid values:

video: video.
audio: audio only
MediaType.description_zh:
媒体文件类型，取值：

video：视频。
audio：纯音频

Status.description_en:
The resource status. Valid values:

Init: The source file is not ready.

Preparing: The source file is being prepared, for example, being uploaded or composed.

PrepareFail: The source file failed to be prepared, for example, failed to obtain source file information.

Normal: The source file is ready
Status.description_zh:
资源状态。取值范围：

Init（初始状态：源文件未就绪）

Preparing（源文件准备中：比如上传中或者剪辑合成中）

PrepareFail（源文件准备失败：比如获取源文件信息失败）

Normal（正常：源文件已就绪）

PlayInfoList.description_en: The audio or video playback information (stream information)
PlayInfoList.description_zh: 音/视频播放信息（流信息）

items.description_en: The detailed audio or video information

Bitrate.description_en: The bitrate of the media stream. Unit: Kbps

CreationTime.description_en: The creation time. The time follows the format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ (UTC)

Definition.description_en:
The definition of the video stream. Valid values:

FD: low definition.
LD: standard definition.
SD: high definition.
HD: ultra-high definition.
OD: original quality.
2K: 2K.
4K: 4K.
SQ: standard sound quality.
HQ: high sound quality.
AUTO: adaptive bitrate
Definition.description_zh:
视频流清晰度定义。取值：

FD：流畅。
LD：标清。
SD：高清。
HD：超清
OD：原画。
2K：2K。
4K：4K。
SQ：普通音质。
HQ：高音质。
AUTO：自适应码率

Duration.description_en: The duration of the media stream. Unit: seconds

Encrypt.description_en:
Indicates whether the media stream is encrypted. Valid values:

0: not encrypted.
1: encrypted
Encrypt.description_zh:
媒体流是否加密流，取值：

0：否。
1：是

EncryptType.description_en:
The encryption type of the media stream. Valid values:

AliyunVoDEncryption: Alibaba Cloud video encryption.
HLSEncryption: HLS standard encryption.

If the encryption type is AliyunVoDEncryption, only the Alibaba Cloud Player SDK can be used for playback
EncryptType.description_zh:
媒体流加密类型。取值：

AliyunVoDEncryption：阿里云视频加密。
HLSEncryption：HLS标准加密。

如果加密类型为AliyunVoDEncryption，则只能使用阿里云播放器SDK才能正常播放

FileURL.description_en: The OSS URL of the file

Format.description_en:
The format of the media stream.
If the media file is a video, valid values are mp4 and m3u8.
If the media file is audio only, the value is mp3
Format.description_zh:
媒体流格式。
若媒体文件为视频则取值： mp4、 m3u8。
若是纯音频则取值：mp3

Fps.description_en: The frame rate of the media stream. Unit: frames per second
Fps.description_zh: 媒体流帧率。单位：帧/每秒

HDRType.description_en:
The HDR type of the media stream. Valid values:
HDR
HDR10
HLG
DolbyVision
HDRVivid
SDR+
HDRType.description_zh:
媒体流HDR类型。取值：
HDR
HDR10
HLG
DolbyVision
HDRVivid
SDR+

Height.description_en: The height of the media stream. Unit: px

ModificationTime.description_en: The modification time. The time follows the format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ (UTC)

NarrowBandType.description_en:
The Narrowband HD type. Valid values:

0: normal.
1.0: Narrowband HD 1.0.
2.0: Narrowband HD 2.0.

This parameter takes effect only when the definition of a Narrowband HD 1.0 built-in transcoding template is configured. For more information, see [Transcoding template configuration - Definition]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/52839.html）
NarrowBandType.description_zh:
窄带高清类型。取值：

0：普通。
1.0：窄带高清1.0。
2.0：窄带高清2.0。

仅当配置了窄带高清1.0内置转码模板的清晰度时才会生效。更多详情，请参见[转码模板配置-Definition]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/52839.html）

PlayURL.description_en: The playback URL of the video stream

Size.description_en: The size of the media stream. Unit: bytes

Status.description_en:
The media stream status. Valid values:

Normal: normal.
Invisible: invisible
Status.description_zh:
媒体流状态，取值：

Normal：正常。
Invisible：不可见

StreamTags.description_en: The stream tag that identifies the transcoding processing type
StreamTags.description_zh: 流标签，用于标识转码处理类型

StreamType.description_en: The media stream type. If the media stream is a video, the value is video. If the media stream is audio only, the value is audio
StreamType.description_zh:
媒体流类型。
若媒体流为视频则取值：video，若是纯音频则取值：audio

TransTemplateType.description_en:
The transcoding templatetype. Valid values:
Normal: normal template.
AudioTranscode: audio transcoding.
Remux: encapsulation conversion.
NarrowBandV1: Narrowband HD 1.0.
NarrowBandV2: Narrowband HD 2.0.
UHD: audio and video enhancement (ultra-high definition)
TransTemplateType.description_zh:
转码模板类型，取值：
Normal：普通模板
AudioTranscode：音频转码
Remux：转封装
NarrowBandV1：窄带高清1.0
NarrowBandV2：窄带高清2.0
UHD：音画增强（超高清）

WatermarkId.description_en: The watermark ID associated with the current media stream
WatermarkId.description_zh: 当前媒体流关联的水印ID

Width.description_en: The width of the media stream. Unit: px
